patch:
diff --git a/forgecalc/calculator.py b/forgecalc/calculator.py
index 644c671..92bd873 100644
--- a/forgecalc/calculator.py
+++ b/forgecalc/calculator.py
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 def percentage(value: float, percent: float) -> float:
     """Return percent of value."""
-    return value * percent
+    return value * percent / 100
 
 
 def clamp(value: float, lower: float, upper: float) -> float:

steps.title: Queue and isolate
steps.summary: The API queued the pinned task. A separate worker claimed it and created disposable agent and verification copies.
steps.evidence: Base commit: b8d1da9a4a165ea89cbbc5d0392a53eb9218bb1c. The source fixture was left unchanged.

steps.title: Inspect the repository
steps.summary: ForgeBench mapped the small Python repository and selected relevant source and test excerpts.
steps.evidence: The run trace records repository analysis, retrieval results, and selected files.

steps.title: Plan the change
steps.summary: Groq returned a validated plan targeting the percentage function.
steps.evidence: 718 input tokens and 275 output tokens were recorded for planning.

steps.title: Edit one function
steps.summary: The model searched, read the source, and changed the percentage calculation to divide by 100.
steps.evidence: Three repository tool calls; only forgecalc/calculator.py changed.

steps.title: Run the target test
steps.summary: The percentage-specific pytest passed in the isolated Docker sandbox.
steps.evidence: 1 passed. The sandbox had no network access.

steps.title: Review and verify the exact patch
steps.summary: Whitespace and patch-scope checks passed. ForgeBench applied the same patch to a second clean copy and checked expected percentage values.
steps.evidence: The independent clean-copy check passed. The configured source checkout remained unchanged.

steps.title: Record completion
steps.summary: The run finished successfully in one attempt.
steps.evidence: 5,634 input tokens; 539 output tokens. Provider-reported cost was unavailable. One task is a smoke trial, not a benchmark score.
